title: Sonify — Data Sonification Studio
description: Draw a curve or pick a dataset, hear it as a pitch glide, plucked rhythm, or chord pad, then export a real WAV.
concept: A data-to-sound instrument: choose a built-in dataset (sine, stock index, temperature, population growth) or hand-draw your own curve, then hear the same data three different ways — a continuous pitch glide, quantized rhythm plucks, or sustained chord pads — across five musical scales and five instrument timbres. Every parameter (scale, root, octave range, ADSR, brightness, tempo) is tunable, and the full sequence renders offline to a downloadable WAV.
features: 5 datasets incl. freehand drawing (pointer + touch) resampled to 200 points
3 distinct sonification engines — pitch-curve glide, discrete rhythm plucks, layered chord pads — each using a different Web Audio scheduling technique
5 scales × 12 roots × 4-octave range, 5 instrument timbres (sine/triangle/saw/square/FM bell) with tunable attack/release/brightness
Offline-rendered WAV export via OfflineAudioContext + manual 16-bit PCM encoding
Named patch library (save/load/delete) plus autosave and a btoa/atob shareable URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag on the chart to draw a custom curve when in Draw mode; sliders tune scale, timbre, ADSR, tempo
interaction.click: Segmented buttons switch dataset / mode / waveform; Play, Stop, Export WAV, Copy Share Link
interaction.touch: Full pointer + touch drawing support, 44px+ tap targets, mobile-first single-column layout under 760px
interaction.keyboard: Standard tab/enter/space activation on all buttons, selects and range sliders
